decisions.finding: Initial consonant Vav in וַיִּקְרָא sits at cols 1335..1315, rows 503..569 of extension-volumeA-592-zoom4-upper-right.png on Line 3. Directly at the base of the Vav stem at rows 573..585 sits a clear horizontal Patah bar (width 29 px, height 12 px, min brightness 0), above the distinct sublinear Hireq dot of Yod at rows 589..605. Note is retired with Patah restored to initial Vav -> וַיִּקְרָא.

Initial consonant Vav in וַיֹּאמַר sits at cols 990..965, rows 503..563 of extension-volumeA-592-zoom4-upper-right.png on Line 3. Directly at the foot of the Vav stem at rows 573..581 sits a solid horizontal Patah bar (width 27 px, height 9 px, min brightness 0), with sublinear space beneath (rows 583..605) confirmed completely blank pure white paper. Note is retired with Patah restored to initial Vav -> וַיֹּאמַר.
